Raipur Cosmetic Factory Raided, Pakistani Cream Seized

Authorities in Raipur conducted a raid on a cosmetic factory after discovering 236 tubes of Pakistani 'Gori' cream that were allegedly being manufactured without a license. The raid revealed the unlicensed production of this cream.
